name: SI /summary rangeInDays=7 returns no data - root cause
description: Investigating why GET /si/summary?rangeInDays=7 returns no data while rangeInDays=2 works. ECS SI-qa on cluster ANEQAWEBSVC-001, account 642960533737. Suspected: SIElasticSearchService counts hits with SIStateType.valueOf(state) which only supports ORIGINAL/REPLACE; an out-of-enum state value in the wider window throws and fails the whole summary.

entries.summary: Root-cause investigation of SI /summary rangeInDays=7 returning no data (rangeInDays=2 works)
entries.detail:
Model: claude-opus-4.8.
Summary path: SIResource.getSummaryByCompanyId -> SIService.getSISummary -> SIElasticSearchService.getSISummary (ES) + EDIReconcileDao.getEDIReconcile (Oracle).

Verified:
1) ES layer is HEALTHY and returns MORE data for 7d than 2d. Queried the qa ES domain (search-inttra2-qa-es-bk-search-...us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com, alias 'si' -> index 'si_v2', 145,053 docs) via SigV4. Replicated the exact app query (match requestorId + range lastModifiedDateUtc gte, size 1000, no sort): company 1002660 -> 7d total=794 (729 ORIGINAL+65 REPLACE) vs 2d total=254; company 802441 -> 7d=408 vs 2d=153. So ES is not the cause of 'empty'.
2) lastModifiedDateUtc mapping = date type, format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss||yyyy-MM-dd||epoch_millis' - range works across the Aug/Sep month boundary.
3) Distinct state values index-wide = ONLY ORIGINAL and REPLACE, so SIStateType.valueOf() (enum has only ORIGINAL/REPLACE) does NOT throw. Not the cause.
4) No company exceeds 1000 SIs in the 7d window (max 794), and ES size caps at 1000, so Oracle ORA-01795 (IN-list>1000) is NOT currently triggered.
5) No server ERROR logs in SI-qa (log group inttra2-ecs-logs, stream prefix SI-latest-qa-Task) since deploy or over 7 days ('Error in SI Service', 'Reconcile', 'ERROR' all empty). So the 7d call is NOT throwing app-side.
6) Only 2 real /si/summary calls in SI-qa logs in last 3 days, BOTH Aug 31, BOTH rangeInDays=7 -> 200/144B/~150ms. But those were for COMPANY 1000 which has 0 SIs (empty fast response) - does NOT prove 7d works for a company WITH data.
7) ALB alb-qa-api-e2open idle_timeout=60s; targets healthy. CloudWatch TargetResponseTime = 0 datapoints over 2 days on both SI target groups (tg-qa-sisummary, tg-qa-sisummary-e2open) -> SI-qa is currently receiving NO client traffic; user's current failing calls are NOT hitting SI-qa (api-beta routing SI elsewhere now).

Latent code issues found in summary path (both UNCHANGED by the AWS upgrade commit):
A) EDIReconcileDao.getEDIReconcile builds 'internal_reference IN (#INTTRA_REF_IDS)' via raw String.join of up to 1000 IDs, nested inside a MAX()/GROUP BY scan of inttra.EDI_RECONCILE. Scales with #IDs -> 7d window (hundreds of IDs) can be slow and exceed the 60s ALB idle timeout -> client gets no data with NO app error/log (prime hypothesis). Also SQL-injection-style concatenation + latent ORA-01795 if MAX_RESULT_SET_SIZE ever raised above 1000.
B) SIElasticSearchService.buildElasticSearchRequest uses size=MAX_RESULT_SET_SIZE(1000) with NO sort -> for any company with >1000 SIs in the window, counts are silently truncated/wrong.

Deployment timing: AWS-upgrade commit 588c531b85 (ION-16396, authored 2026-08-18) deployed to SI-qa since ~2026-08-19 (ECS deployment PRIMARY createdAt 2026-08-19T20:39 EDT, task def SI-latest-qa-Task:7). Current running tasks restarted TODAY 2026-09-03 08:11 EDT (deployment updatedAt 08:14), image centos:SI-dev digest sha256:a6af3c6a... The AWS-upgrade commit did NOT change SIElasticSearchService or EDIReconcileDao (summary query logic), so the 7d failure is a pre-existing data-volume/latency issue, not introduced by the upgrade.</detail>

entries.summary: DEFINITIVE root cause: /summary latency scales with SI count; 7d/14d exceed UI client timeout for high-volume company 1002660 (backend returns 200 in 7-9s). Plus ES size=1000 truncation bug.
entries.detail:
Reproduced against the live beta API by authenticating as the two test users (POST https://api-beta.inttra.com/auth password grant, then GET https://api-beta.inttra.e2open.com/si/summary?rangeInDays=N).

qacloud2+001@inttra.com -> companyId 1002660 (AutoCustomer1, HIGH volume):
  1d: HTTP200 2.96s (submitted178) | 2d: 200 2.87s (234) | 7d: 200 7.29s (submitted729/amended65) | 14d: 200 8.99s (931/69).
qacloud2+878821_2@inttra.com -> companyId 878821 (LOW volume):
  1d:1.18s 2d:1.10s 7d:1.65s 14d:2.33s, all HTTP200.

ROOT CAUSE (definitive): The SI /summary backend WORKS and returns HTTP 200 for all ranges, but response latency scales with the number of SIs in the window. For a high-volume company the 7d (~7.3s) and 14d (~9s) responses exceed the my-beta frontend/gateway client read-timeout (~5s), so the browser UI shows 'no data' for 7/14 days while <=48h (<=3s) succeeds. Low-volume company never exceeds ~2.3s so it always works. This is why there are NO 500s / ERROR logs server-side.

Latency driver: EDIReconcileDao.getEDIReconcile builds 'internal_reference IN (<up to 1000 ids joined by comma>)' via raw string concat, nested inside 'select MAX(edi_reconcile_id) ... group by internal_reference' scanning inttra.EDI_RECONCILE. Cost scales with #IDs (1d~184 -> 3s, 14d~1000 -> 9s). ES part is fast.

Secondary bug (correctness): SIElasticSearchService.buildElasticSearchRequest uses size=MAX_RESULT_SET_SIZE(1000) with NO sort. For 1002660 at 14d, submitted+amended = 931+69 = exactly 1000 => ES result truncated at 1000 => counts undercounted for windows with >1000 SIs.

NOT a regression from the AWS SDK 2.x upgrade (ION-16396): that commit did not modify SIElasticSearchService or EDIReconcileDao. Symptom emerged as company SI volume grew.

Recommended fixes: (1) Replace client-side hit-counting with ES aggregations (terms agg on state within the requestorId+date filter) to get submitted/amended counts without fetching/truncating docs; (2) rewrite EDIReconcileDao query with bind parameters + chunk IDs in batches of <=1000 (fixes latency-driving pattern, ORA-01795 latent risk, and SQL-injection-style concat), and ensure inttra.EDI_RECONCILE is indexed on internal_reference; (3) short-term: raise the frontend/gateway timeout for the summary call.</detail>

Passwords replaced with <PASSWORD> placeholders.</detail>
